Learning_Outcome: Understand AgriShine/GrowMeal purpose, learning architecture, level progression and the 12-week cycle.
Apply site, tool, learner-supervision, food-contact and incident-control standards.
Operate level-appropriate gardens, water systems, tools, inputs, maintenance and records.
Teach technical language and model practical procedures effectively.
Prepare, facilitate, differentiate and assess hands-on GrowMeal practical work.
Develop age-appropriate observation, measurement, recording and evidence quality.
Facilitate applied challenges without solving them for learners.
Teach ingredient investigation, post-harvest thinking, food journeys and food-safety boundaries.
Facilitate evidence-based food, water, waste, storage and resource decisions.
Assess four dimensions, apply 0-3 rubrics, moderate judgments and manage reassessment.
Verify learner achievements and manage level-completion evidence.
Build a coherent weekly sequence using the full GrowMeal resource chain.
Adapt access, roles, scaffolding and extension while preserving learning standards.
Use operational records, KPIs, teacher observation and school certification evidence.
Demonstrate a complete GrowMeal lesson/practical under observation.
